board.note: Standard 15x15 Scrabble board. Premium squares apply only on first use. Center star (7,7) acts as double word and must be covered by the first word.

tile_bag.note: 100 letter tiles shuffled face-down. Server draws tiles; only the drawing player sees them.

rack.note: Each player's tile rack. Holds up to 7 tiles, visible only to the owner.

letter_tile.note: 98 lettered tiles plus 2 blanks (wildcards, 0 points). Distribution: A-9, B-2, C-2, D-4, E-12, F-2, G-3, H-2, I-9, J-1, K-1, L-4, M-2, N-6, O-8, P-2, Q-1, R-6, S-4, T-6, U-4, V-2, W-2, X-1, Y-2, Z-1, blank-2.

phases.name: setup
phases.note: Shuffle all 100 tiles into the bag, deal 7 to each player's rack.

phases.name: play
phases.note: Each turn the active player must do exactly one: place a word on the board, exchange tiles (if bag has tiles remaining), or pass.

phases.name: refill
phases.note: Draw tiles from bag to refill rack to 7 (or as many as remain).

place_word.definition: Place 1-7 tiles from rack onto the board in a single row or column
constraints: all tiles placed in a single horizontal row or single vertical column
placed tiles plus existing tiles form a contiguous word with no gaps
all cross-words formed must be valid dictionary words
at least one placed tile must be adjacent to an existing tile (except first turn)

first_word.definition: The first word played must cover the center square (7,7)
first_word.note: Center star square acts as a double word score for the first word.

blank_tile.definition: Blank tiles may represent any letter but score 0 points
blank_tile.constraint: player must declare which letter the blank represents when placing it

exchange_tiles.definition: Return 1-7 tiles from rack to the bag, draw the same number of replacement tiles
constraints: tile_bag must have at least 7 tiles remaining

pass.definition: Player passes without placing tiles or exchanging; scores 0 for this turn

scoring.definition: Sum of letter point values for all tiles in the formed word, multiplied by any premium square bonuses
constraints: double_word: entire word score is doubled
triple_word: entire word score is tripled
premium bonuses apply only on first use of that square
blank tiles always score 0 regardless of premium squares

bingo_bonus.definition: 50-point bonus for placing all 7 tiles from rack in a single turn

end_game_penalty.definition: When the game ends, each player subtracts the sum of point values of tiles remaining on their rack
end_game_penalty.effect: if one player used all tiles, that player also adds the sum of all opponents' remaining tile values

word_validation.definition: All words formed (primary and cross-words) must appear in the game dictionary
word_validation.note: Dictionary validation requires WASM extension; the specific dictionary (TWL, SOWPODS, etc.) is configured in the WASM module.

library.tiles_on_board: count of occupied cells on board
library.consecutive_zero_turns: count of consecutive turns where no tiles were placed by any player
